### Added

- *(model-manager)* Accept a backends list — one model-manager in front of several serving backends: guards for every listed driver (enum, duplicates, Ollama/Lemonade endpoint, kserve API), one host-server egress rule per listed host backend and the Hub egress when kserve is listed, in both flavors in [#263](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/263) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/compare/v3.6.0...v3.7.0
